titles.es: Cuando la ciencia se encuentra con lo desconocido

subtitles.zh: 人类认知的边界，与永不终结的探索
subtitles.en: The Limits of Human Knowledge and the Endless Search for Understanding
subtitles.fr: Les limites de la connaissance humaine et la quête infinie de compréhension
subtitles.es: Los límites del conocimiento humano y la búsqueda interminable de la comprensión

note: Four-language manuscripts reviewed for editorial consistency and publication approved by publisher on 2026-11-09.

descriptions.zh:
当科学不断拓展人类认知的边界，我们是否仍然保有对未知的敬畏？

从古代《周易》的变化思想，到现代科学对生命、意识与宇宙的探索，本文重新思考知识、智慧与先见之明的关系，并追问：为什么科技高度发达的今天，我们依然需要哲学？

这不是一篇试图证明科学与玄学孰高孰低的文章，而是一次关于人类认知局限、古代智慧与永恒好奇心的思想探索。
descriptions.en:
As science continues to expand the boundaries of human knowledge, have we lost some of our capacity for wonder?

Drawing on the ancient Chinese Book of Changes, modern scientific discoveries, and enduring philosophical questions, this essay explores the relationship between knowledge, wisdom, and the unknown.

Why do ancient ideas continue to matter? Does technological progress necessarily make us wiser? And can we respect scientific evidence while remaining humble before questions we have yet to answer?

A reflective exploration of humanity’s endless search for understanding.
